title: Create app_typography.dart token file
description: Create typography tokens at lib/ui/core/tokens/app_typography.dart. Wraps GoogleFonts callables; do NOT cache. File imports: `import 'package:flutter/material.dart';` AND `import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';`. Class `AppTypography` with private constructor `AppTypography._();`. All 15 styles as `static TextStyle` (not const because GoogleFonts returns a runtime TextStyle — that's expected; do not attempt to make them const). Two helper private getters (`_fredoka(...)`, `_nunito(...)`) reduce repetition. Required TextStyles: displayLarge (Fredoka, 57px, w700, -0.25 letterSpacing, 64/57 height); displayMedium (Fredoka, 45px, w600, 0, 52/45); displaySmall (Fredoka, 36px, w600, 0, 44/36); headlineLarge (Fredoka, 32px, w600, 0, 40/32); headlineMedium (Fredoka, 28px, w500, 0, 36/28); headlineSmall (Fredoka, 24px, w500, 0, 32/24); titleLarge (Nunito, 22px, w600, 0, 28/22); titleMedium (Nunito, 16px, w600, 0.15, 24/16); titleSmall (Nunito, 14px, w500, 0.1, 20/14); bodyLarge (Nunito, 16px, w400, 0.5, 24/16); bodyMedium (Nunito, 14px, w400, 0.25, 20/14); bodySmall (Nunito, 12px, w400, 0.4, 16/12); labelLarge (Nunito, 14px, w500, 0.1, 20/14); labelMedium (Nunito, 12px, w500, 0.5, 16/12); labelSmall (Nunito, 11px, w500, 0.5, 16/11). Headings (display* + headline*) use `GoogleFonts.fredoka(...)`; everything else (title* + body* + label*) uses `GoogleFonts.nunito(...)`. Top-of-file doc comment describes font pairing rationale + pt-BR considerations (Nunito's rounded forms support extended Latin).
acceptance_criteria: All 15 TextStyle constants declared inside class `AppTypography` (with private constructor `AppTypography._();`)
All TextStyles are `static` (using getter returns since GoogleFonts is runtime — common Dart pattern)
Headings (displayLarge, displayMedium, displaySmall, headlineLarge, headlineMedium, headlineSmall) use `GoogleFonts.fredoka(...)`
Title + Body + Label styles (titleLarge, titleMedium, titleSmall, bodyLarge, bodyMedium, bodySmall, labelLarge, labelMedium, labelSmall) use `GoogleFonts.nunito(...)`
Font sizes/weights/letter spacings/heights match DESIGN_PLAN section 1.3 spec exactly (57/45/36/32/28/24 for headings, 22/16/14 titles, 16/14/12 bodies, 14/12/11 labels)
Line heights expressed as fractions (e.g. 64/57) for clarity rather than computed decimals
All string literals use double quotes
No emojis anywhere in the file
Top-of-file doc comment describes font pairing and pt-BR considerations
completion_summary: Created lib/ui/core/tokens/app_typography.dart with 6 Fredoka heading styles + 9 Nunito body/title/label styles via GoogleFonts, flutter analyze passes
